edit.description: root `groom.agent`'s session capture at `api.paths.flumeDir`, per the cited section
the placement's two behaviors, driven through a real groom tick

summary: Teach the backlog-groomer example to root a per-run artifact at `api.paths.flumeDir`; the cited section says `examples/` shows it and no example reads `api.paths` at all.
tests: the backlog groomer example writes its session capture under the flumeDir the engine handed its factory
a relocated flumeDir moves the backlog groomer's session capture with it
acceptance: The groomer resolves its capture dir off `api.paths.flumeDir`, both lines are green, and the section's `examples/` claim resolves on disk.
notes: `withSessionCapture` tees `onStdout` only and `groomAgent` never fires it, so a straight wrap ships an empty capture file — emit the groom line through `inv.onStdout` too. The decorator is on `api`; the example imports `join`, not `resolve`. Captures land untracked in the fixture repo, outside the phase fence the engine judges on the commit.
